prompt: Review this new skill against the skill-standards checklist and report problems.
setup: A skill directory contains a SKILL.md and one references file.
The description is written in the second person and names no triggers.
expected: The frontmatter, body, and references are checked item by item.
The weak second-person description with no triggers is flagged.
Findings are reported with the specific rule each one violates.
must_not: Approve the skill despite the description defect.
Report best-practice advice without naming the violated rule.
Modify the skill instead of reporting findings unless asked.
